scope: immutable initial official DeepSeek-V4-Flash report/config/inference/kernel release; model weights and upstream code not executed; later revisions and third-party implementations excluded

official_architecture_factorization.interaction: local plus one compressed operator within a layer; CSA/HCA interact across the depth schedule

official_HCA_semantics.KV_projection: one learned hidden-to-head vector per source token
official_HCA_semantics.score_projection: one learned hidden-to-head channel-wise score per source token
official_HCA_semantics.pooling: per-channel softmax over m' positions followed by weighted KV sum
official_HCA_semantics.query: shared low-rank latent then per-head up-projection and RMSNorm

official_CSA_semantics.two_projection_halves: a from current m-token block and b from previous m-token block
official_CSA_semantics.pooling: one per-channel softmax over 2m current-a plus previous-b positions
official_CSA_semantics.selected_object: compressed KV entry, not raw token block
official_CSA_semantics.indexer_key: separate same-overlap compressed projection with rotation and low-precision simulation
official_CSA_semantics.indexer_score: sum over ReLU query-key head affinities weighted by learned per-query head weights

official_local_and_normalization_semanti.local_entry: raw projected and normalized KV with partial RoPE

official_causal_state_semantics.completed_entry_visibility: visible at and after the query that completes the entry's current source block
official_causal_state_semantics.HCA_tail: float32 KV and score state for the current non-overlapping m'-token block
official_causal_state_semantics.CSA_tail: float32 prior-half plus current-half KV and score state for overlapping compression
official_causal_state_semantics.raw_local_state: ring over the latest window-size exact KV entries
official_causal_state_semantics.completed_compressed_state: separate cache appended after the raw-window index space

HCA_v1.preserved: non-overlap, causal completed-entry emission, incomplete tail, compressor-before-rate isolation, state/compute accounting
corrections: add exact dynamic channel-gated projection/position-bias/RMSNorm source compressor after the three simpler controls
label no-local variant HCA core rather than the full published HCA operator
freeze HCA/CSA as an interleaved layer schedule rather than parallel same-layer branches

CSA_v1.preserved: oracle-first feasibility, selector metrics, causal exclusion, separate objectives, explicit complexity/state accounting
corrections: selected units are overlapping compressed entries with 2m support after the first, not contiguous raw blocks
HCA remains fixed through an interleaved layer schedule rather than a simultaneous coarse branch
the unfinished compressed entry is excluded and current-block access belongs to the raw local window

raw_local_v1.preserved: shared query within a compressed-attention layer, one union softmax, exact raw ring, local-specific endpoints and cost accounting
corrections: do not deduplicate raw and compressed entries merely because their underlying source-token supports overlap
identity is representation family plus cache-entry index; only exact duplicate identities are removed
place local coverage at each selected HCA/CSA layer unless placement is itself a separate intervention

source_disposition.next_action: freeze coordinated HCA/CSA/raw-local v2 corrections before any sequence implementation; retain active-finalist and parent blockers
